title.narrative: Burkina Faso COVID-19 Preparedness and Response Project

description.narrative: The proposed Project will be part of the COVID-19 Strategic Preparedness and Response Program using the Multiphase Programmatic Approach (MPA). The proposed Project will fill critical financing gaps that have been identified due to the new emergency preparedness and response needs created by COVID-19. The proposed project will consist of two components: Component 1: Emergency COVID-19 Response; and Component 2: Implementation Management and Monitoring and Evaluation. The first component provides immediate support to Burkina Faso to limit local transmission through containment strategies. Supported activities will mostly be related to: (i) case detection, confirmation, contact tracing, recording, and reporting; (ii) social distancing measures and prevention; (iii) health system strengthening; (iv) Communication Preparedness, communication and Community Engagement; and (v) Social and Financial Support to Households. The second component supports project management, monitoring and evaluation, and the learning agenda.
To prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19, and strengthen national systems for public health preparedness in Burkina Faso.

condition.narrative: Per ESCP, the Recipient will update, publish, adopt and implement the following parent project tools and instruments byEffectiveness and prior to the commencement of activities:▪ Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF), including anESMP, an Action Plan for the fight against EAS/HS;▪ Infection Control and Waste Management Plan (ICWMP);▪ StakeholderEngagement Plan (SEP);▪ Labor Management Plan (LMP) ;▪ Grievance Mechanism (GM).

Schedule 2, Section 1, A, 2. No later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, or any later date as agreed by the Association,the Recipient shall recruit and thereafter maintain, throughout Project implementation: (i) a procurement specialist; (ii) amonitoring and evaluation specialist; (iii) an environmental specialist and; (iv) a social development specialist, with terms ofreference, functions, experience, integrity, responsibilities and qualifications acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section 1, A, 3. The Recipient shall, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, recruit an externalauditor, with qualifications and under terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.
Schedule 2, Section 1, A, 4. The Recipient shall, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, customize the Project'saccounting software, in a manner acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section 1, B, 1. The Recipient shall, by not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, or any later date asagreed by the Association, update and adopt a Project implementation manual (“Project Implementation Manual”), containing detailed guidelines and procedures for the implementation of the Project, including with respect to: administration and coordination,monitoring and evaluation, financial management, procurement and accounting procedures, environmental and socialaspects, corruption and fraud mitigation measures, a grievance redress mechanism, personal data collection andprocessing in accordance with applicable national law and good international practice, roles and responsibilities for Projectimplementation, and such other arrangements and procedures as shall be required for the effective implementation of theProject, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

The Recipient shall by no later than one (1) month after the Effectiveness Date or such later date as agreed in writing by theBank, the Recipient shall cause the PIU to appoint and hire throughout Project implementation key staff i.e.: (i) a Projectcoordinator, (ii) a social specialist, (iii) a procurement specialist, and (iv) an accountant until completion and such key staffwith functions, experience, integrity, responsibilities and qualifications acceptable to the Association.

The Recipient shall by no later than one (1) month after the Effectiveness Date, prepare and adopt a Project Implementation Manual(“Project Implementation Manual”) containing detailed guidelines and procedures for the implementation of the Project, includingwith respect to: administration and coordination, monitoring and evaluation, financial management, procurement and accountingprocedures, environmental and social safeguards, corruption and fraud mitigation measures, a grievance redress mechanism, personaldata collection and processing in accordance with applicable national law and good international practice, roles andresponsibilities for Project implementation, and such other arrangements and procedures as shall be required for the effectiveimplementation of the Project, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

The Recipient shall by no later than two (2) months after the Effectiveness Date enter into an agreement with ASCE-LC in form andsubstance satisfactory to the Association for the purposes of carrying out bi-annual audits of the Project.
The Recipient shall, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, customize the Project's accounting software, in amanner acceptable to the Association.
The Recipient shall, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, recruit an external auditor, with qualifications andunder terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.
